description: This source file contains integration tests for the MongoReadJournal component, testing snapshot retrieval, deletion handling, and PID extraction in a MongoDB-backed persistence layer using Akka Streams and JUnit.

classes.name: MongoReadJournalIT
classes.description: Integration test class for MongoReadJournal, verifying snapshot retrieval, deletion handling, and PID extraction logic in a MongoDB environment using Akka Streams.

methods.name: startMongoResource
methods.description: Sets up the MongoDB resource and client before any tests are run.

methods.name: stopMongoResource
methods.description: Tears down the MongoDB resource and client after all tests are finished.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the ActorSystem, Materializer, and MongoReadJournal instance before each test.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Cleans up resources: drops the test database and shuts down ActorSystem after each test.

methods.name: streamLatestSnapshotsWithBatchCutOffWithinSamePid
methods.description: Test method: verifies that the journal returns the latest snapshots for multiple PIDs, respecting batch size and filtering out deleted entries.

methods.name: streamLatestSnapshotsWithDeletedSnapshots
methods.description: Test method: ensures that only non-deleted latest snapshots are returned, even when some entries are marked as deleted.

methods.name: extractJournalPidsFromEventsAndNotSnapshots
methods.description: Test method: checks that PIDs are correctly extracted from journal event documents, ignoring snapshot documents.

methods.name: extractJournalPidsAboveALowerBound
methods.description: Test method: verifies that PIDs are correctly retrieved when applying a lower boundary filter.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Helper method to insert multiple documents into a specified MongoDB collection within the test setup.
